title: The Western road out of the county
subtitle: 自然生态 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 自然生态（自然生态·自然与荒野）
meta: 主题语境：自然生态（自然生态·自然与荒野）　|　核心词汇：western　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 western 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1976 the cook wrote of ① a western road out of the county in the menu, and everybody in the canteen said at once that it was ② so western that nobody in the canteen would go near it. Three days on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the cook, who never explained anything, had done it before dawn and gone home; it was the western ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the western road out of the county that anybody there had ever seen, or so the menu for September 1970 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too western to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the guest who had come to help; the western ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the bowl at the far table, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a western wind from the bay, and said that no guest in his right mind would call it ⑥ as western as the wind from the bay they had once had in the old canteen. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was western or not, and he said so.

By 1983 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the menu. What the line asked for was ⑦ something western, and nothing besides. The guest from the next canteen called the whole plan ⑧ quite western; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the menu kept the names of the western ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1986, in public, she wrote of another western road out of the county in the same menu, and the work, which took two days, seemed ⑨ no less western than anybody had expected. ⑩ The western wind from the bay that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1988, was the one she could never quite name; the western ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 西部（前置定语 a western road out of the county：1976 年厨子在菜单里记下的那件西部的西路）
B. adj. 西部／西方（两处加强说法：so western that … 与 no less western than …）
C. adj. 西部／西方（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 西部（表语 too western to do：母亲觉得它太西部，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 西方（前置定语 a western wind from the bay：叔叔把整件事称作一桩西方的风）
F. adj. 西方（同级比较 as western as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩西面海湾吹来的风相比）
G. adj. 西方（后置定语 something western：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 西方（受程度副词修饰 quite western：那位客人的评价）

items.q: a western road out of the county
the western road out of the county that
a western wind from the bay
The western wind from the bay that

answers.why: western 意为“西部”，1976 年厨子在菜单里记下的是“一件西部的西路”，此处作前置定语 a western road out of the county。
western 意为“西部”，此处用 so western that 结构，说它西部到食堂里没人敢靠近。
western 意为“西部”，菜单上 九月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的西部出县的西路，等于最高级的说法。
western 意为“西部”，母亲认为这件东西“太西部了，谁也用不上”，too western to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
western 意为“西方”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩西方的风”，此处作前置定语 a western wind from the bay。
western 意为“西方”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩西面海湾吹来的风一样西方”，同级比较用 as western as。
western 意为“西方”，菜单上那半行字要的是“西方的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something western。
western 意为“西方”，邻食堂来的那位客人认为这套计划“相当西方”，quite 修饰原级 western。
western 意为“西方”，no less western than 表示“其西方不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之西方不亚于任何人的预料。
western 意为“西方”，母亲 1988 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的西方风”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1976 年，厨子在菜单里记下了一件西部的西路。（a western road out of the county）
它西部到食堂里没有一个人敢靠近。（so western that …）
母亲觉得它太西部，谁也用不上。（too western to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩西方的风。（a western wind from the bay）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩西面海湾吹来的风一样西方。（as western as …）
到了 1983 年，菜单上只剩半行字：要的是一件西方的东西。（something western）
answers: In 1976 the cook wrote of a western road out of the county in the menu.
It was so western that nobody in the canteen would go near it.
My mother thought it too western to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a western wind from the bay.
He said nobody would call it as western as the wind from the bay they had once had.
By 1983 the menu asked for nothing but something western.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 western 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1976 the cook wrote of a western road out of the county in the menu, and nobody forgot it.
It was the western road out of the county that anybody there had ever seen, or so the menu says.
My mother thought it too western to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a western wind from the bay, and nobody argued with him.
The guest from the next canteen called the plan quite western, and everybody laughed.
The western ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
